# P1.20 — Settings, account, data & privacy, integrations

Spec: `docs/tickets/48_P1.20__settings-account-data.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.20.md`
**Stage A only** — code + deterministic tests at $0. Stage B (dev deploy + migration `0040` + the
live email-change/support-access/export/deletion legs on a throwaway account, $0) is operator-gated
→ `D-P1.20-1`. The merge is **operator-held**.

Stacks on `stevevitali/p1-19-notifications-inbox` (P1.19).

## Summary

The §14.7 settings tree lands at the §4.2 paths — six visible sections
(`/app/settings/{account,preferences,notifications,integrations,billing,data}`, ⌘, opens it, Team
stays hidden until roles ship) — reusing the landed machinery rather than duplicating it: P1.19's
notification-prefs store, P1.16's billing surfaces, P1.15's connections, P1.18's account
export/import, and P1.09's approval-policy + standing-guidance half of `/p/:project/settings`.
Account deletion is the spec's typed-`delete` → 14-day grace → `account.hard-delete` worker job that
destroys content + PII while retaining the anonymized ledger rows and the Stripe customer (what tax
law needs). The support-access toggle mints a 72-h grant with a user-visible audit log mirrored by
the operator's `admin_actions` row. The Q-26 preference profile ships honestly capture-only:
`guidance.preference_signal` records write-time eligibility, the opt-out flips the next capture, the
blob rides the account zip, and the §11.7 copy renders verbatim — aggregation is 1.x.

## What changed

- **Contracts** (`packages/contracts/src/settings.ts`): `SETTINGS_SECTIONS`/`VISIBLE_SETTINGS_SECTIONS`
  (Team in the vocabulary, out of the nav), `userPrefsSchema`/`parseUserPrefs` (tier/rigor/
  approval-policy defaults, per-workflow rigor, editor prefs, `preferenceOptOut`), the account/
  preferences/data/integrations/project-settings DTOs, `ACCOUNT_DELETION_CONFIRMATION`,
  `SUPPORT_ACCESS_TTL_MS` (72 h), `preferenceCaptureEnabled`.
- **DB** — migration `0040_settings_account.sql`: `"user".prefs`/`deletion_requested_at`/`byline`;
  `support_access_grants` + `support_access_log` (user-visible REQ-VIS-11 mirror);
  `admin_actions` gains `'support_access'`; `projects.protocol_changed_at` + `protocol_overrides`;
  `projects.rigor_default` drops NOT-NULL + the phantom `'standard'` default (NULL = inherit the
  account default live); `guidance.preference_signal`.
- **API** (`apps/api/src/settings-routes.ts`): account read/write + magic-link email change +
  session list/revoke; `GET/PUT /settings/preferences` with null-delete; `GET /settings/data`
  (privacy + support grant + log + deletion state); support-access toggle (idempotent while active);
  `/settings/preference-profile`; typed-confirmation delete → `account.hard-delete` enqueue at the
  grace end + cancel; the uniform integrations read + disconnect (same-write `auth_ref` null, items
  kept); `GET/PUT /projects/:id/settings` (safe fields only; a protocol change stamps
  `protocol_changed_at`). `approval-routes.ts` gains `PUT /projects/:id/guidance/:gid` (in-place
  edit, 409 on retired). `admin-cli support-access` refuses without a live grant and dual-writes
  the log + audit row.
- **Run sheet / scope**: `sheet-context` returns the resolved rigor/tier chain (project override →
  per-workflow pref → account default → 'standard') + `protocolChanged`; `run-sheet` renders the
  marker line + the blocking scope consequence; `run-routes` derives `scopeBlocking` server-side
  (Full board, protocol/venue change, or the pending marker on a Review) and clears
  `protocol_changed_at` once a non-deduped Review carries it.
- **Worker**: `handleAccountHardDelete` — re-reads the marker (a cancel no-ops), anonymizes
  `usage_records`, cascades content + PII, retains `billing_accounts`/`credit_ledger`/
  `credit_balances`; registered as the `account.hard-delete` consumer.
- **Archive**: `state.json` `preferences` gains the `prefs` blob — the opt-out flag + account
  defaults ride the zip (the importer still leaves the fresh account's own prefs alone).
- **Web**: the six-section tree with a shared nav strip; legacy `/settings` +
  `/settings/billing` GETs redirect/serve and every legacy POST action keeps working (billing POSTs
  are dual-mounted and redirect back to whichever base they came from); the analytics toggle moved
  into Data (one surface, one column); the notifications form fans out per-project opt-ins to match
  the api's one-project-per-write contract; `/p/:slug/settings` carries venue/protocol/rigor/tier/
  paper theme/protocol overrides + the approval policy + standing-guidance list/edit/retire; ⌘, and
  the IDE rail gear point at `/app/settings`.

## Design choices recorded

- Typed confirmation is the literal `delete` (the spec pins "typed confirmation", not a string).
- `approval_policy` + `paper_theme` stamp at project create (NOT NULL columns need a concrete pick);
  `rigor_default`/`model_tier_default` stay NULL — NULL is the live-inherit sentinel, not a frozen
  copy.
- `preference_signal` is evaluated at write time and fails closed (a lookup error marks the row
  ineligible); opting out flips the next capture — the row still lands, the run still consumes it.
- Support access: one active grant per user; toggling on while active is idempotent; every
  grant/revoke/access writes `support_access_log` (newest-first in the UI).
- Tags on project settings are a placeholder line (1.x).
- The web forwards the typed confirmation verbatim — the API is the authority (a wrong string
  redirects `?notice=confirmation-required`).
